name: XLA_AE_HEADERS
description: This table contains subledger accounting journal entries.

columns.name: AE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of accounting entry.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Functional area within a software suite of products. For example, Financials or Payroll.

columns.name: ACCT_RULE_DEFINITION_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier of an accounting rule definition that was used to generate the accounting.

columns.name: APPLIED_DESCRIPTION_PRIORITY
columns.description: Rule priority of the successfully evaluated description rule that was used to create the journal entry description.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Self-contained accounting information set for single or multiple legal or management entities.

columns.name: ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Subledger transactions associated with the accounting events.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the categorization of accounting events that is unique within an application and event class.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an event type and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_DATE
columns.description: Date, referenced from Oracle Fusion General Ledger, used to determine the accounting period for transactions.

columns.name: GL_TRANSFER_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: General Ledger transfer status code.

columns.name: GL_TRANSFER_DATE
columns.description: Date when journal entry is transferred to general ledger.

columns.name: JE_CATEGORY_NAME
columns.description: Group of journal entries with similar characteristics such allocations, accruals, or revenues.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_ENTRY_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status code of the accounting entry.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_ENTRY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code that uniquely identifies the source of accounting entry generation: Standard or Manual.

columns.name: AMB_CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description: Accounting methods builder context.

columns.name: PRODUCT_RULE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Application accounting definition type code, not applicable for manual adjustments.

columns.name: PRODUCT_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Application accounting definition type code, not applicable for manual adjustments.

columns.name: PRODUCT_RULE_VERSION
columns.description: Version of the rules, not applicable for manual adjustments.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of a subledger journal entry.

columns.name: DOC_SEQUENCE_ID
columns.description: Sub-Ledger document sequence identifier.

columns.name: DOC_SEQUENCE_VALUE
columns.description: Sub-Ledger document sequence value.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Identifier of accounting batch program.

columns.name: COMPLETION_ACCT_SEQ_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Accounting sequence version identifier.

columns.name: CLOSE_ACCT_SEQ_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Reporting sequence version identifier.

columns.name: COMPLETION_ACCT_SEQ_VALUE
columns.description: Name of the sequence used to generate a unique number for the journal when the journal is posted.

columns.name: CLOSE_ACCT_SEQ_VALUE
columns.description: Name of sequence used to generate unique number for the journal when the period is closed.

columns.name: BUDGET_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of budget version.

columns.name: FUNDS_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status resulted from a fund check performed on a journal entry. Valid values include Pass, Fail, Not Attempted, Reserved, and Not Required.

columns.name: ENCUMBRANCE_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of encumbrance type assigned to a journal entry in the encumbrance accounting.

columns.name: BALANCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Balance type. Values are Actual, Budget, or Encumbrance.

columns.name: REFERENCE_DATE
columns.description: Accounting entry reference date.

columns.name: COMPLETED_DATE
columns.description: Subledger journal entry  completion date.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Fiscal period that reports financial results, such as a calendar month or fiscal period.

columns.name: PACKET_ID
columns.description: Budgetary control packet defining column.

columns.name: COMPLETION_ACCT_SEQ_ASSIGN_ID
columns.description: Accounting sequence assignment identifier.

columns.name: CLOSE_ACCT_SEQ_ASSIGN_ID
columns.description: Reporting sequence assignment identifier.

columns.name: DOC_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Subledger document sequence category.

columns.name: GROUP_ID
columns.description: Interface group identifying column.

columns.description: Subledger document sequence version identifier.

columns.description: Subledger document sequence assignment identifier.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: UPG_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of upgrade batch.

columns.name: UPG_SOURCE_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier of the upgrading application.

columns.name: UPG_VALID_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if validation was successfully run for the batch.

columns.name: ZERO_AMOUNT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicate whether the entry is a zero-amount entry.

columns.name: PARENT_AE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Journal entry header id of the parent entry.

columns.name: PARENT_AE_LINE_NUM
columns.description: Journal entry line number of the parent entry.

columns.name: ACCRUAL_REVERSAL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the subledger journal entry is an accrual reversal entry.

columns.name: MERGE_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of merge accounting event.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: NEED_BAL_CODE
columns.description: Tracks when balancing is necessary.

columns.name: AE_PENDING_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Shows the temporary status for accounting entry generation. The value is for internal use only.

columns.name: INTERCOMPANY_REVERSED_CODE
columns.description: Tracks whether the intercompany lines for this journal have been reversed.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity that owns this accounting entry. Will be populated only when there is one and only legal entity for the accounting entry.

columns.name: SUBLEDGER_XCC_COMPLETE_STATUS
columns.description: Status used to determine if budgetary control is performed on general ledger entries

columns.name: MULTIPERIOD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the journal entry contains any line that requires multiperiod accounting. Possible values are Y (journal contains multiperiod accounting line) and N (journal does not contain multiperiod accounting line).

columns.name: PARTITION_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Partition grouping information, when combined with the period, determines the database partition in which this journal will be stored.

columns.name: ACCRUAL_REVERSAL_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the accrual reversal option code, which is used to create the accrual reversal entry for a manual journal entry.
